title: WELFARE SCHEMES FOR SCHEDULED TRIBES IN BIHAR
text:
Press Release Page | Press Information Bureau

Ministry of Tribal Affairs

WELFARE SCHEMES FOR SCHEDULED TRIBES IN BIHAR

प्रविष्टि तिथि:
30 JUL 2026 1:49PM by PIB Delhi

Replying to a question in Lok Sabha today the Union Minister of State for Tribal Affairs Shri Durgadas Uikey informed that
the Ministry is regularly coordinating with concerned line Ministries/Departments / State Tribal Welfare Department / other line State Departments for implementation of the existing interventions under the PM JANMAN, DA JGUA and other tribal development schemes to expedite the progress and achievements. Such reviews are undertaken at least once in a quarter and during the current financial year 2026–27, these review meetings have been held on 06.05.2026 and 10.07.2026.

The details of the financial progress under relevant schemes of MoTA in the State of Bihar are given in
Annexure-I
. The district-wise financial progress is not maintained in the Ministry as the responsibility of allocation of funds to districts lies with the State Government.

The details of the benefits given under PM JANMAN, as on 30.06.2026, District-wise, in Bihar, are given at
Annexure II.

Under DAJGUA interventions, 108 houses have been completed under PMAY-G, 1 tribal skilling centres has been established by MSDE in West Champaran and D/o Fisheries has approved 138.25 lakhs projects for 50 members. District-wise beneficiary data is maintained by the respective implementing Ministries/Departments. The details of projects approved by Ministry of Tribal Affairs in Bihar, District wise, under DA JGUA are given at
Annexure III.

Further, Ministry of Tribal Affairs has sanctioned 3 Eklavya Model Residential Schools (EMRSs) in the State of Bihar. As on date, 2 EMRSs are functional. The details are as under:

Under DAJGUA, 19 tribal hostels have been sanctioned in State of Bihar through Samagra Shiksha scheme of Ministry of Education intervention with a sanctioned cost of Rs 6042 lakh and central share of Rs 906.30 lakh released. Further, under the Ashram Schools & Hostels intervention of MoTA under DA JGUA, 5 major repair works in tribal residential schools have been sanctioned in Bihar.

The details of beneficiaries covered under Pre Matric Scholarship and Post Maric Scholarship schemes in State of Bihar are given in
Annexure IV
.
